notes.title: Maze: Pedestal of Trials is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

It has been a long time in the making, but the spin off sequel to "Maze" is finally available on Steam!

Maze: Pedestal of Trials takes everything you love about Maze, and steps it up a notch!

There is a brand new checkpoint system to help you navigate through difficult mazes and all new interactive puzzles. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892240/Maze_Pedestal_of_Trials/

If you are a fan of the first game, or a fan of TreeFall experiences, you will love Maze: Pedestal of Trials!

I hope you enjoy this new Maze journey!

-Eli

notes.title: A New Puzzle Game From TreeFall Studios
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736670/Tilting_Tiles/


What is going on everyone!? How is everyone in The Perplexing Orb community doing!?

I wanted to thank you all personally for playing The Perplexing Orb 2. Rolling around, grabbing artifacts, and crushing some finish posts. If you enjoyed The Perplexing Orb 2, chances are you might be interested in the brand new puzzle game we just launched last month.

We released a brand new game called Tilting Tiles. Tilting Tiles is a minimalist movement based puzzle game. It is unique and stands alone in a niche puzzle genre. We would love to get your feedback on the game. You can check it out on Steam now!

Have a wonderful night everyone.

-Eli
